Class PaymentRequest

public class PaymentRequest

DTO carried into the Invocable / @AuraEnabled actions on BankPaymentFlowController to initiate a bank payment. Each field is exposed both as @InvocableVariable (so Flow can wire it) and @AuraEnabled (so Lightning can pass it). billId is optional to support manual payments not tied to a Bill__c record.

@AuraEnabled
@InvocableVariable(required=true description='Amount that will be send for the payment' label='Payment Amount')
